Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between three locations: the test location, location B and location C.
    • How to do it: Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154839 LOCATION C in Name * and click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location, at location B (active there) and at location C (inactive there), under the same part number.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154839 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154839-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save. Then switch to location B and create part A again with the same Part Number, then switch to location C and do the same and set it inactive there: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154839-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
